scientific_comparison_summary.overall_continuous_rmse_winner: B2 (Global ML: 8.37 mm vs B4: 9.40 mm)
scientific_comparison_summary.overall_continuous_mae_winner: B4 (VarshaMitra Soft MoE: 3.88 mm vs B2: 4.12 mm)
scientific_comparison_summary.honest_conclusion: Global ML (B2) minimizes squared continuous residuals across widespread light-to-moderate rain. The Regime-Aware Soft MoE (B4) provides targeted physical advantages in absolute error (MAE), operational threshold threat score (CSI), and disaster-critical extreme precipitation detection (POD >= 64.5 mm).
